title: feat: support GLM-5.2 ShareIndex with custom VPP layouts
bodyExcerpt:
Fixes #1782

## What this PR does / why we need it?

1. Adds PP/VPP-aware global decoder-layer mapping for GLM-5.2 ShareIndex so each Share layer resolves the intended Compute source inside the same process-local PP/VPP chunk, and rejects groups split across chunk boundaries.
2. Reuses MindSpeed `PipelineModelParallelLayoutFeature` and `PipelineParallelLayerLayout` as the runtime layout parser, validator, layer-count provider, and layer-offset provider. `--num-layer-list` remains the legacy non-VPP uneven-PP mode, while `--pipeline-model-parallel-layout` independently describes custom PP/VPP placement; the two modes are now rejected when configured together.
3. Uses the MindSpeed layout offset when MindSpeed-LLM selects global-layer-dependent TransformerBlock behavior, including Dense/MoE, attention-pattern, and noop-layer decisions.
4. Persists `pipeline_model_parallel_layout` in checkpoint arguments, detects distribution-mode conflicts after checkpoint restoration, and extends HF-to-MCore and MCore-to-HF conversion with the same VPP-major/PP-major global-layer mapping, including uneven layouts and layout-defined uneven PP without VPP.
5. Keeps legacy `num_layer_list`, uniform VPP, and DualPipeV paths unchanged when no custom layout is configured, and updates the GLM-5.2 POC command to use the layout as the sole custom PP/VPP distribution argument.

## Does this PR introduce any user-facing change?

Yes. `--num-layer-list` and `--pipeline-model-parallel-layout` are mutually exclusive alternatives. For PP=4/VPP=5 custom placement, use `--pipeline-model-parallel-layout 'Ett|(tttt|)*18ttttL'` without `--num-layer-list`. The legacy `--num-layer-list "18,20,20,20"` mode remains available for uneven PP without custom VPP layout. Quote the layout in conversion shell commands because it contains the shell pipe character `|`.

## How was this patch tested?

1. Ran the repository-configured pre-commit hooks on all 10 PR files. Trailing-whitespace, end-of-file, added-large-fi

title: [Feature]: support GLM-5.2 ShareIndex with custom VPP layouts
bodyExcerpt:
### Background

GLM-5.2 ShareIndex training needs custom virtual pipeline parallelism with uneven decoder-layer placement. `--num-layer-list` is the existing non-VPP uneven-PP distribution mode, while `--pipeline-model-parallel-layout` is the MindSpeed layout mode that fully describes PP/VPP chunks, embedding, decoder, and loss placement. The two arguments are alternative layer-distribution modes and must not be configured together. Runtime and checkpoint conversion must derive the same PP/VPP-to-global-layer mapping from the layout alone.

### Expected implementation

1. Treat `--num-layer-list` and `--pipeline-model-parallel-layout` as mutually exclusive alternatives at training, checkpoint restore, and conversion boundaries.
2. Reuse MindSpeed `PipelineParallelLayerLayout` to validate the custom layout and resolve decoder-layer counts and global offsets for every PP/VPP chunk.
3. Ensure every ShareIndex layer resolves the intended compute source without crossing a process-local PP/VPP boundary.
4. Build and load the correct number of VPP model chunks, persist the layout in checkpoint arguments, and reject conflicting command-line/checkpoint distribution modes.
5. Support custom-layout HF-to-MCore and MCore-to-HF conversion while remaining compatible with Megatron Core v0.12.1.

### Acceptance criteria

- `--pipeline-model-parallel-layout 'Ett|(tttt|)*18ttttL'` alone produces 78 unique global decoder layers across PP=4 and VPP=5.
- Supplying `--num-layer-list` and `--pipeline-model-parallel-layout` together fails with an explicit mutual-exclusion error.
- Each ShareIndex consumer resolves the expected compute source within the same local PP/VPP chunk, with explicit validation errors for invalid split boundaries.
- HF/MCore conversion uses the same layout mapping in both directions, and the resulting VPP checkpoint can be loaded with the configured layout.
- The PR remains a single review commit and the repository checks for the changed-file scope are reported fact

title: [bugfix] Fix dense MLP double norm under transformer_engine
bodyExcerpt:
### What

Fix double RMSNorm in DeepSeek/GLM dense MLP layers when `--transformer-impl transformer_engine` is enabled.

### Why

For dense/MoE mixed models, dense layers use `_get_mlp_module_spec(use_te=True)`, which builds `MindSpeedTELayerNormColumnParallelLinear` for `mlp.linear_fc1`. This module already contains fused pre-MLP norm.

However, `pre_mlp_layernorm` was still kept as `PTNorm`, causing dense layers to apply RMSNorm twice:

- external `pre_mlp_layernorm`
- internal norm in `MindSpeedTELayerNormColumnParallelLinear`

### How

In `TransformerBlock.build_layer`:

- MoE layers keep `pre_mlp_layernorm = PTNorm`
- Dense TE layers use `pre_mlp_layernorm = IdentityOp`
- Dense local layers keep `pre_mlp_layernorm = PTNorm`

### Verification

Verified with GLM/DeepSeek dense + MoE mixed training:

- dense TE layer: `IdentityOp + MindSpeedTELayerNormColumnParallelLinear`
- MoE TE layer: `PTNorm + TEGroupedMLP`
- training accuracy comparison passed
